يستصحبوا (form X)
# يَسْتَصْحِبُوا (yastaṣḥibū) /jas.tasˤ.ħi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# يُسْتَصْحَبُوا (yustaṣḥabū) /jus.tasˤ.ħa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
